subject: https://cometweb.io/pricing — Growth dual-currency, Free CTA, Studio vs Growth features

payload.research_contract: QUICK verification of 3 material claims on CometWeb marketing pricing page; as_of 2026-08-26 Europe/Warsaw; live HTTP fetch of EN /pricing and PL /pl/pricing.

material_claims.text: Growth tier monthly price is shown in both PLN and USD on the pricing page.
Free plan primary CTA links to app.cometweb.io/register without billing/plan query params.
Studio tier lists features/capabilities distinct from Growth (not identical copy).

claims.claim_text: Growth tier monthly price is shown in both PLN and USD on the pricing page.
claims.falsifier_summary: Checked EN /pricing SSR for simultaneous PLN+USD Growth numerals; only USD ($39/mo) rendered. PL /pl/pricing shows 159 zł. Absence of dual-currency simultaneous display does not falsify locale/currency-selector model.

evidence.summary: FACT: EN pricing SSR shows Growth monthly price as $39/mo.
FACT: PL pricing SSR shows Growth monthly price as 159 zł/mc.

evidence.locator: billing note + currency selector (USD/PLN labels in SSR)
evidence.summary: FACT: Page states PLN and USD are separate price lists; USD/PLN selector present. INFERENCE: Both currencies are supported on the pricing page via locale/currency selection, but a single default EN SSR snapshot does not render both numerals at once.

claims.claim_text: Free plan primary CTA links to app.cometweb.io/register without billing/plan query params.
claims.falsifier_summary: Searched live HTML for app.cometweb.io/register? on EN /pricing; none found. Bare register URL present once.

evidence.locator: Free plan card primary CTA ('Create free account')
evidence.summary: FACT: SSR HTML embeds destination https://app.cometweb.io/register with no query string; no register? URLs on page.

claims.claim_text: Studio tier lists features/capabilities distinct from Growth (not identical copy).
claims.falsifier_summary: Compared Growth vs Studio feature blocks and comparison table; numeric limits and Studio-only EAA line differ; not identical copy.

evidence.locator: Growth card features + Studio card ('Everything from Growth, plus:') + comparison table
evidence.summary: FACT: Growth lists 300 Comet Credits/mo, crawl up to 200 pages, 30 days data history. Studio lists 550 credits/mo, crawl up to 500 pages, 90 days history, and EAA-readiness accessibility screening — distinct copy and limits, not a duplicate feature list.

gaps: Client-side currency toggle on https://cometweb.io/pricing was not exercised in this pass; PLN Growth price on the EN URL after manual USD→PLN switch is inferred from locale/currency UX, not live-click verified.
Free CTA is implemented as a button-driven navigation in app code; live fetch confirms bare register URL in SSR payload but did not execute a click-through to confirm runtime redirect lacks params.
contradictions: CLAIM-1 wording 'shown in both PLN and USD' is ambiguous: simultaneous dual display on one SSR view is false; dual-currency availability across pricing page experience is true.
